Hi Anna — thanks for the context and the PO. Short answers up front: yes, we can do staged activation under the same private offer; and we can support a multi-execution DocuSign flow (tranches).

High-level plan:
- We prepare a single Private Offer with an acceptance window that supports staged activation: tranche 1 (EU) activates on signing of first set of DocuSign envelopes, tranche 2 (US) follows on second envelope, tranche 3 reserved for overflow/burst.
- Signing order: Solstice (procurement) -> Redwood legal -> Solstice legal (if they need cross-signature) — we can flip the order to have Redwood countersign after Solstice signs if you prefer immediate provisioning.
- Required PO fields to avoid acceptance delays: PO number, billing contact (email + phone), requested activation date per region, and VAT/Tax ID for EU billing.

I've attached the DocuSign template we use for tranches and a sample naming convention for the PO. Suggest we lock the DocuSign window to 10 business days for the first tranche and keep subsequent tranches open for 30 days. If Procurement needs 10 days for all tranches we can compress but that may delay provisioning.

Next steps: 1) confirm desired signing order, 2) provide billing contact and VAT ID, 3) confirm which tranches you want active immediately.

I'll loop in Karthik for billing flow and Kimberly for marketplace acceptance details.

Best,
Soojin Lee

Thanks for the heads-up. A couple of procurement/billing notes from my side:
- For a single PO across tranches we need the PO to explicitly list the aggregate commit and the tranche allocation by region (example: EU 40% of commit, US 60%). We map those to usage buckets at acceptance.
- Invoices will follow the private-offer billing cadence. If Solstice wants invoices split by region we need a clear billing contact per region and the VAT registration number for EU ops.
- If the EU activation is earlier, please confirm whether the EU bucket will be billed pro-rata from the activation date. Standard practice is pro-rata for partial period activation; we can confirm with Finance for your preferred invoicing.

If you want the DocuSign signing order changed (e.g., Redwood signs last), note that countersigning last gets you provisioned faster once Solstice signs.

I can prepare the acceptance matrix and send a one-page summary you can attach to the PO to speed legal review.

-Karthik
